questions.question: Find the odd one from the given alternatives. दिए गए विकल्पों में से विषम ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Except option 3, in all other groups, the middle letter is a vowel.

Hence the option 3 is the odd one.

We have:

ABCDEFGHIJKLM
12345678910111213
NOPQRSTUVWXYZ
14151617181920212223242526

J (10 ) + Q (17) = 27

M (13) + N(14) = 27

W (23) + D(4) = 27

C(3) + Z(26) = 29

questions.question: Find the odd one out: विषम ज्ञात करें:
questions.solution:
EF _ H _ _ K

PQ _ _ T _ _ W

CD _ _ G _ _ J

MN _ _ Q _ _ T

The position values of the alphabets are used where A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on.

Except (1) EFHK rest all follows the same pattern i.e., there is a gap of two alphabets between second and third alphabet, and similarly between third and fourth alphabet.

We have:
ABCDEFGHIJKLM
12345678910111213
NOPQRSTUVWXYZ
14151617181920212223242526

G + 3 = J

The reverse order letter for G is T and similarly for J is Q.

K + 3 = N

The reverse order letter for K is P and similarly for N is M.

B + 3 = E

The reverse order letter for B is Y and similarly for E is V.

S + 3 = V

The reverse order letter for S is H and similarly for V is E.

Hence, (d) is the correct option

questions.solution:

L-3= I; L+5= Q

V-3= S; V+5= A

W-3= T; W+5=B

J-3= G; J+5= O
All the numbers are divisible by 37 except 594.

Z + 2 = B, B + 3 = E, E + 5 = J

The other options follow the same trend except VYDG.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: विषम ज्ञात करें:
questions.solution:
As per the alphabetical order series

Forward position value of M= Reverse position value of N

Forward position value of G= Reverse position value of T

Forward position value of J= Reverse position value of Q and not P

Forward position value of E= Reverse position value of V

We have:

ABCDEFGHIJKLM
12345678910111213
NOPQRSTUVWXYZ
14151617181920212223242526

H(8) + R(18) = 26

C(3) + X(24) = 27

J(10) + Q(17) = 27

G(7) + T(20) = 27
